outputs.explanation: Panel A shows flow cytometry dot plots where each point already represents an individual cell (event); these are not summary/average plots, so no additional individual data point display is needed.
Panel B shows flow cytometry dot plots of individual cell events, not averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C shows flow cytometry gating plots displaying individual cell events rather than averaged/summary statistics.
Panel D is a color-coded overlay of flow cytometry dot plots showing individual cell events for each population (MBC, GC, naive), not an average with error bars.
Panel E shows flow cytometry gating plots of individual cell events, not summary/average data requiring individual point overlay.
